verdict.rationale: Gusto publishes a large OpenAPI 3.1 spec covering Companies, Flows and other areas, plus webhooks, an agent-friendly CLI and an MCP server, so a broad programmatic surface clearly exists. Nothing documents UI parity, and the new formation, banking and Money Dashboard features appear only as UI-guided flows with no API evidence. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of business formation, banking and cash-flow dashboard features, independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
